# oncallalert Provider

Manage a self-hosted OnCallAlert server (escalation policies, schedules, rotations, services, ...) as code.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    oncallalert = {
      source = "OnCallAlert/oncallalert"
    }
  }
}

# Point the provider at your own server. The token needs Admin scope
# (profile page -> API Tokens). Both can also come from ONCALLALERT_URL / ONCALLALERT_TOKEN.
provider "oncallalert" {
  url   = "https://oncall.example.com"
  token = var.oncallalert_token
}

variable "oncallalert_token" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `insecure_skip_verify` (Boolean) Skip TLS certificate checks. Only for test servers with self-signed certificates.
- `timeout_seconds` (Number) HTTP timeout per API request, in seconds. Default 30.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) API token with Admin scope (profile page -> API Tokens). Can also be set with `ONCALLALERT_TOKEN`.
- `url` (String) Base URL of your OnCallAlert server, e.g. `https://oncall.example.com`. Can also be set with `ONCALLALERT_URL`.
